title: A Vector for the Machine
author: T. M. Vane
blurb: Xanthe Villalobos, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
